verdicts.rationale: Reonomy's API documentation is on public pages (docs home, getting-started, basics and release notes) and describes matching addresses to properties, locating properties by geography, asset type and building area, bulk ingestion, and endpoints such as POST /property/bulk.
verdicts.missing: The pack shows only summary capability text and one endpoint from a Sept 2020 release note rather than a current endpoint reference, the newest release note is Mar 2021, and using the API needs an approved access request through sales and is limited to enterprise customers (c1, c2, c3).

verdicts.rationale: Nothing in the pack mentions a Reonomy MCP server.
verdicts.missing: Any official MCP server, its setup steps or its release status.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no Reonomy SDK, CLI, package-registry listing or public code repository.
verdicts.missing: Any vendor-maintained SDK or CLI, or even code samples or a pointer to an unofficial library.

verdicts.rationale: The pack presents Reonomy as a licensed data set of 53M+ US commercial properties that customers match against, search and ingest, and shows no records that change on a customer's behalf.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not show the full endpoint list or state outright that customers keep no changeable records in Reonomy, and it shows no webhook or change-notification feature for data updates.

verdicts.rationale: Every API request needs credentials (an access key and secret key sent with HTTP Basic Authentication), but the basics page describes no scopes, roles or permissions that limit what a key can do.
verdicts.missing: Whether keys can be limited by scope or role, whether separate keys can be issued for an agent, and whether scoping is documented anywhere beyond the basics page.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no OpenAPI, Swagger, GraphQL or other machine-readable specification for the Reonomy API.
verdicts.missing: Any downloadable or in-docs machine-readable API specification.

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows no llms.txt file and no Markdown versions of the API documentation pages.
verdicts.missing: Any llms.txt file or Markdown documentation.

verdicts.rationale: Every API function the pack shows (address matching, property search, bulk ingestion and POST /property/bulk returning property information) only reads Reonomy's published property data.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not show the complete endpoint reference, so it cannot fully rule out write endpoints, and it shows no sandbox or test environment.

verdicts.rationale: The web app has an Exports feature for up to 2,000 property records a month, while larger bulk pulls go through the API or bulk feed plans, which are sold through Talk to an expert.
verdicts.missing: The export file format (CSV, Excel or JSON) and any documentation of the Exports feature are not shown, and the bulk routes need an approved request through sales (c2).

verdicts.rationale: The pricing page invites buyers to select a subscription and get instant access to the property and ownership data, with only the bulk feed and API plans routed to Talk to an expert.
verdicts.missing: No probe or capture of the sign-up or checkout flow confirms that no call is needed, no plan prices are shown, and API access is enterprise-only and sales-gated (c2, c3).

verdicts.rationale: The pricing page lists monthly, annual, bulk feed and API plans but shows no dollar amounts, and the API plan offers only Talk to an expert.
verdicts.missing: Any price, fee or starting price for any plan, including the monthly or annual subscription a small sponsor would buy.

verdicts.rationale: The public API docs say the API matches addresses to Reonomy properties and that POST /property/bulk returns information for the specified property IDs, with asset type and building area among the attributes properties can be located by.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not list the attributes returned (such as size, year built or use) or show a response schema or parcel-number lookup, the endpoint note dates to Sept 2020, and API access needs an approved request (c1, c2).

verdicts.rationale: The pack shows property search by geography, asset type and building area but nothing about sale or lease transactions or comparables.
verdicts.missing: Any sale or lease comp data, comp filters or transaction coverage in the API or app; the pack also does not show that Reonomy lacks transaction data, so na does not apply.

verdicts.rationale: The pricing page says a subscription gives access to ownership data, but the pack never shows the API or any data service returning the owner of record or a mailing address as structured data.
verdicts.missing: Whether the API returns owner of record and mailing address as structured fields, and how ownership data is delivered; the only support is a pricing-page marketing line.

verdicts.rationale: The public API docs describe locating properties by geography and ingesting Reonomy data in bulk (typically over 10k records), and the pricing page claims up to 1M properties in a single API request.
verdicts.missing: The pack does not show the area-search endpoint or confirm it returns every record for an area (the only endpoint shown takes 250 property IDs per call), the 1M figure is a pricing-page claim, the bulk feed and API plans need a sales conversation, and web-app exports are capped at 2,000 records a month (c8).
